info.name: TiDB Cloud API Keys Audit Logs API

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Default is 100, maximum is 100.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Pagination token returned from a previous list request to retrieve the next page.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Filter audit logs starting from this ISO 8601 datetime.

params.name: endTime
params.description: Filter audit logs up to this ISO 8601 datetime.

params.name: auditEventTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of event types to filter by.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Search term to filter audit log entries.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of console audit logs for the organization. Audit logs capture administrative actions such as cluster creation, deletion, and configuration changes, along with the user email, timestamp, and result of each action. Supports filtering by time range, event type, and keyword.
